summary: Facepalm: Search found one usable facepalm: the Chicago "move the Bean" crowd event, with two accepted sources. Most other leads were animal stories, crimes with victims, or had only one accepted source. Genius: Searched widely. Only one candidate cleared the rules: the FDA's Nov. 9 approval of Bayer's asundexian (Sunharbo), a first-in-class stroke drug. Phys.org and similar pages were inaccessible or too old, and sports records lacked a second accepted source. No genius story met the standard; nothing published. The verified facepalm story is on the bench for a later day.
